entities.name: head-to-head comparison approach
entities.description: A method for evaluating performance by comparing outputs directly using an LLM evaluator.

entities.name: LLM evaluator
entities.description: A system using a Large Language Model to judge relative performance of answers.

entities.name: Comprehensiveness
entities.description: A criterion measuring how much detail an answer provides to cover all aspects of the question.

entities.name: Diversity
entities.description: A criterion measuring how varied and rich an answer is in providing different perspectives.

entities.name: Empowerment
entities.description: A criterion measuring how well an answer helps the reader understand and make informed judgments.

entities.name: Global Sensemaking
entities.description: An activity-based task targeting global understanding rather than specific details.

entities.name: Podcast transcripts
entities.description: A dataset of podcast transcripts used for generating global sensemaking questions.

entities.name: News articles
entities.description: A dataset of news articles used for generating global sensemaking questions.

relationships.description: The LLM evaluator is used to implement the head-to-head comparison approach.
The LLM evaluator judges performance according to the Comprehensiveness criterion.
The LLM evaluator judges performance according to the Diversity criterion.
The LLM evaluator judges performance according to the Empowerment criterion.
The LLM evaluator is used to assess the quality of answers to Global Sensemaking tasks.
Podcast transcripts are used as a source for Global Sensemaking tasks.
News articles are used as a source for Global Sensemaking tasks.
